notes.title: Development Status Report 2025/08/23
notes.notes:
[p]We sincerely apologize for the delay.
Here is an update on the current development status.
Below, we provide details for each element that is currently being improved or added.[/p][p][b]Change in Attack Order Based on AGI (Agility)[/b]
Previously, AGI only affected the enemy’s evasion rate. From now on, the character with higher AGI will also attack first. This change increases the importance of AGI, which until now has not been a particularly significant stat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/6b496f4992a4a48910432a67885c209d2ccaa5b2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Addition of the World Map[/b][/p][p]The [b]“To the Forest”[/b] button will be changed to a [b]“Map”[/b] button, allowing players to select side quests in addition to the main quest.[/p][p]Each side quest will be unlocked once its specific conditions are met.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/d4cb1326aa759b359ff9b2d7f0a735d973d1c3e3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Addition of Side Quests[/b][/p][p]Side quests are relatively short quests consisting of about 10 to 20 stages, each with its own storyline and completion rewards.[/p][p]Compared to the main quest, side quests allow for faster leveling and provide a more fast-paced, strategy-oriented gameplay experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/3477ed87ea24dd48848cc80f1bc3a1dd2f073db3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Revision of Monsters’ Special Attacks[/b]
In the main quest, special abilities that restricted gameplay—such as counterattacks against specific spells or the complete nullification of physical and magical attacks—will be replaced with new special abilities.[/p][p][b]Familiar Parameter Adjustments[/b]
The defense of the Golem and Fairy will now increase according to the player’s defense stat.
Additionally, by obtaining the new item [b]“Bell,”[/b] players will be able to choose whether or not to have the Cat attack.[/p][p][b]Change to Equipment Reflection Timing[/b]
The system has been updated so that the wizard’s appearance changes immediately when equipment appears in a slot.
This improves clarity by eliminating the confusing situation where the character’s appearance and the rarity of the equipment in the slot felt mismatched by one tier.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/103705d3baf98896f4910830a250aa98854b1f9a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Title Screen Update[/b][/p][p]The title screen has been updated. In addition, it will change to an alternate version under certain conditions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/1bf4235c70c67fa5e35158a8178ba97322eb44e6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Addition of Main Quests[/b]
In addition to the existing 50 stages, 50 new stages will be added, leading deeper into the Abyssal Forest.
The following elements will be unlocked starting from these newly added stages:[/p][p][b]Addition of New Monsters[/b]
A large number of uniquely powerful monsters, surpassing those encountered so far, will make their appearance.[/p][p][b]Addition of a Higher Rarity Above Legendary: “Mythic”[/b][/p][p][b]Addition of New Items[/b][/p][p]New equipment and items will be added, such as the [b]“Staff,”[/b] which strengthens magic at the cost of not equipping a shield, and the growth-type item [b]“Ultra Soul.”[/b] (Images are not yet available as these items are still under development.)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Closing Remarks[/b][/p][p]As outlined above, numerous improvements and additions are being implemented in preparation for the full release.
Due to the scale of these updates, development is taking longer than originally expected. We deeply apologize for the wait and ask for your continued patience and anticipation.[/p]

notes.title: Thank you very much for taking the time to provide your review
notes.notes: [p]Thank you very much for taking the time to provide your review.[/p][p]At the moment, we are engaged in preparations for a major update, which makes it difficult to implement agile updates right away. The improvements based on your feedback will be addressed together with the upcoming major update, so we kindly ask for your patience until the changes are reflected.[/p][list][*][p]Change to chain reactions after "Legendary" tier: Instead of all chained items disappearing, now only one will disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]The Golem’s physical defense is currently fixed at 1.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fairy’s magical defense is currently fixed at 1.[/p][/*][/list][p]→ These will be adjusted so that their defense reflects one-tenth of the Mage’s defense value.[/p][p]Also, regarding the growth of familiars, it has been implemented in advance with future developments in mind. While the current growth may seem slow, improvements are planned for the future.[/p]

notes.title: Major Version Upgrade - Phase 1
notes.notes:
The first Major Version Upgrade - Phase 1 is now live!

We’ve added new features such as “Familiars,” the appearance of the “Timekeeper,” new items, and also rebalanced existing items. These changes aim to ease the difficulty of early gameplay and make the game rules easier to understand.
Even players who have already cleared the game should find something new to enjoy, so we encourage you to give it another go!

Thank you for all your feedback so far.
We’ll continue to improve the game based on your suggestions, so please keep them coming!
Also, we’ve included a preview of what’s coming in Major Version Upgrade - Phase 2, so be sure to check it out.

We hope you’ll continue to enjoy The Mage’s Servant!

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]

[b]1. “Familiars”
2. New Slot Items
3. Appearance of the Timekeeper
4. New Display Option: Simultaneous Slot Results
5. New Achievements[/b]

[h2][b]1. “Familiars”[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/c0ad06c89c8cb179daf6088d1fc2c12e5e40e1e5.png[/img]
[b]Cat – Ability: Energy Drain[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/fec2d857ffe6e45e8a41074397d8a544ede1e782.png[/img]
[b]Golem – Ability: Physical Defense / Turns into “Metal” when destroyed[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/778350dd82a386929689e9054d036290d2a87f6a.png[/img]
[b]Fairy – Ability: Magic Defense / Turns into “Mana” when destroyed[/b]

Familiars gain experience each time they appear in the slot and can be leveled up using Fragments.

Familiars become available after the “Timekeeper” event occurs.

You can bring only one Familiar with you at a time.

[h2][b]2. New Slot Items[/b][/h2]
Metal – Transforms into adjacent weapon
Mana – Transforms into opposite-element magic when attacked

[h2][b]3. Appearance of the “Timekeeper”[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/1873d5ff8a496b45567fdc23909d2fa870b2b50d.png[/img]
A mysterious monster known as the “Timekeeper” will appear during your adventure, offering advice or prompting choices.

Timekeeper Appearance Condition:
No monsters have escaped during your run.

Note: Familiars and the Timekeeper become central features in the second loop. You don’t need to max out Familiar levels in the first loop. The second loop will also introduce new characters beyond the Timekeeper.

[h2][b]4. New Display Option: Simultaneous Slot Results[/b][/h2]
This new option allows you to skip post-slot animations for faster gameplay.

[h2][b]5. New Achievements[/b][/h2]
Achievements related to the “Cat,” “Golem,” and “Fairy” have been added.

[h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2]

[b]1. Item Rebalancing
2. Visual Updates
3. Volume Adjustments[/b]

[h2][b]1. Item Rebalancing[/b][/h2]
To improve usability, offensive items now affect a wide area, and defensive items have been tuned to act more precisely.

Spear Mastery – Transforms adjacent melee weapons into spears during spear chains

Bow Mastery – Transforms adjacent weapons into bows during bow chains

Wind Ring – Transforms adjacent magic into boots during boot chains

Warding Ring – Transforms adjacent Fruits of Wisdom into robes during robe chains

Fortified Ring – Transforms adjacent herbs into armor during armor chains

Impenetrable Ring – Transforms adjacent coins into shields during shield chains

[h2][b]2. Visual Updates[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/cbaf5720799ce61df79f0af948d27561cf9d4b71.png[/img]
Basilisk
Ghoul
Vampire
Berserker
Magical Princess
Banshee
Dark Lord

[h2][b]3. Volume Adjustments[/b][/h2]
Reduced the volume of certain harsh sound effects.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

Fixed an issue where multiple items could disappear when using the “Ring of Oblivion.”

Fixed a bug where “The Perfect Tea” was not being consumed properly.
Note: While it’s currently possible to clear the game without “The Perfect Tea,” it will become a required item from Major Update Phase 2 onward.

[h2][b]Major Version Upgrade - Phase 2 (Planned Features)[/b][/h2]

[b]Second Loop Stages[/b]

After clearing all 49 stages, the story will branch

Meeting certain conditions will unlock the second loop stages

[b]Features of the Second Loop[/b]

Strengthened monsters with unique abilities

New enhancement item “Ultra Soul” to allow players to use monster abilities

Equipment with rarity higher than Legendary

Additional items

Attack order will be affected by the “Agility” stat

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/72b3fe79bd2ef4504f071e3f50cddb63614a6d0f.png[/img]

ue to the large volume of updates, we have released some of the items from the update we announced the other day as an early patch today.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
Fixed a bug where pressing the confirm button twice was required immediately after entering the shop screen.
A confirmation dialog is now displayed when selecting "Take the Fragment and Leave."

[h2][b]New Feature: High-Speed Mode[/b][/h2]
Added a "High-Speed Mode" that speeds up post-slot chain animations and battle scenes.
Can be enabled in the options menu.

[h2][b]Preliminary SteamDeck Support[/b][/h2]
Players can now use the right analog stick and confirm button, as well as the D-pad to select main options.
(Full support is planned for the future.)

[h2][b]Round Limit Feature[/b][/h2]
If you do not defeat a monster within 20 rounds, the monster will flee and no experience will be awarded.
Boss monsters will enter a berserk state from round 21 onward.
Note: The round limit may be adjusted based on balancing.
Note: In future updates, you may be required to defeat a monster to obtain its “Ultra Soul.”
Note: This will also affect branching paths later on (currently, it has no impact).

[h2][b]Ring Enhancements[/b][/h2]
“Ring of Fate” is now available for purchase from the start.
“Healing Ring” HP recovery increased from 1 to 2.
“Ageless Ring” HP recovery increased from 3 to 5.

[h2][b]Expanded Effects of Chain Items[/b][/h2]
Previously, melee weapons could only chain with other melee weapons.
Now, depending on the weapon, they may chain with ranged weapons or other items as well.
This allows for more efficient builds within the round limits, preventing prolonged battles.

[h2][b]Remaining Update (Update Part 1):[/b][/h2]
Addition of support items with growth elements: “Familiars.”
Addition of conversation events and choices between battles.
Addition of new characters.
Game and story progression changes based on branching choices.

You can choose one to take with you from Golem, Fairy, or Cat.
They offer unique effects as in-slot items that haven’t been seen before.

We’re aiming to release this update within the month — stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes – March 14, 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/72b3fe79bd2ef4504f071e3f50cddb63614a6d0f.png[/img]

This update introduces changes in preparation for future features.

[h2][b]Fragment Acquisition[/b][/h2]
We have added a sequence every 5 stages where players can choose to either proceed as usual or collect fragments and return.
Fragments are used to unlock levels for "Ultra Soul."
Since "Ultra Soul" is not yet implemented, fragments currently have no function. However, players can stockpile them and use them once "Ultra Soul" is introduced.
※Fragments can also be obtained upon clearing all stages.

[h2][b]Enhancement Bonus[/b][/h2]
When equipping Legendary Gear, triggering a chain will now grant an enhancement bonus.
Additionally, unlike before, only the items involved in the chain will disappear, while those that do not chain will remain.

notes.title: Patch Notes – March 12, 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/72b3fe79bd2ef4504f071e3f50cddb63614a6d0f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
Fixed an issue where the BGM in the main menu and shop was excluded from volume adjustments.
[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]
Added support for changing screen resolution.

Initially, we intended to support window size adjustments, but it turned out to be difficult to implement using Unity's built-in features alone. As a result, we have adopted a resolution selection format instead.
You can change the resolution from the OPTIONS screen.
However, if you select a resolution larger than your monitor's native resolution, the game screen may not fit within the monitor display.
In such cases, pressing ALT + Enter will switch the game to fullscreen mode, allowing the screen to fit properly. Please ensure that the selected resolution does not exceed your monitor's native resolution.

notes.title: Considering New Elements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/43a412591def7ef7d552d0aabfcdd853f02bfc9d.png[/img]

We want to add more value to game overs. Instead of just losing money, we are considering introducing additional elements that can be carried over.  
Additionally, instead of implementing direct farming countermeasures (which often come with drawbacks, as seen in the recent difficulty adjustment), we plan to introduce alternative benefits that indirectly discourage farming.

[h2][b]Elements Acquired During Adventures That Can Be Carried Over Even After a Game Over  
Materialized Objects or Concepts = "Ultra Souls"[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Defeating a boss every 10 stages within a set number of rounds grants a powerful item called "Ultra Soul," which can grow when special items are obtained.  
[*] "Ultra Souls" can be carried over even after a game over.  
[*] Multiple "Ultra Souls" can be selected and brought along on adventures (the carrying limit is yet to be determined).  
[*] Additionally, the more "Ultra Souls" are taken on an adventure, the more they absorb the wizard’s magic power, growing and improving their performance.  
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed: Issue where progression became impossible after receiving the reward.
notes.notes:
Multiple reports were received regarding an issue where progression became impossible after defeating the 15th monster and receiving the reward. The cause has been identified, and the issue has been resolved in the current version.

Update: This issue has been resolved as of the 2:00 AM update, as the fix matches the implemented changes.

Cause: If the reward items granted every five stages were out of stock, nothing could be distributed, resulting in the progression issue. This has now been fixed so that when the designated reward items are out of stock, players will receive gold bars instead.

notes.title: I have adjusted the difficulty to make it easier to play.
notes.notes:
The initial difficulty was too high, so I have adjusted it again to make it easier to play.

Additionally, I have made the following changes:
[olist]
[*] Achievements will now be unlocked if you possess "The Finest Tea."
[*] If the reward item for every five stages is out of stock, you will now receive gold bars instead.
[/olist]

notes.title: We will ease the difficulty.
notes.notes: The adjustment leaned too much toward high difficulty, so we will ease the difficulty.

notes.title: Basic Early-Game Progression
notes.notes:
"Sorcerer's Servant" is a roguelike "death game," where the difficulty is particularly high at the beginning. To help you get started, we've put together a guide on the basic early-game progression. We hope you find it useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/bb2e54e483000e1e75e7d049adc775323789f189.png[/img]
▲ Before heading into the forest, you need to choose which items to carry in your bag.
Since the sorcerer has low defense and is prone to being defeated early on, it's recommended to take the following four items:
These items can be retained even if you get a game over.

[list]
[] Herb – Restores HP
[] Ring of Enhancement – Increases max HP when defeating enemies
[] Ring of Endurance – Increases physical defense when defeating enemies
[] Ring of Focus – Increases magical defense when defeating enemies
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/f73acda53de2978bf5e0ab288bcfde402585187b.png[/img]
▲ When facing Kobolds and Goblins, prioritize selecting recovery, defense, and experience-boosting items in the slot system.
If these are not available, choose to skip.
Since early-game enemies have low defense, you can defeat them without needing attack-based items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/9dbe50e125eb7284412e6a2536fd0cc142e1c885.png[/img]
▲ Against Orcs, continue selecting defense-related items at first.
However, since Orcs have high attack power, switch to attack-based items toward the end of the fight to defeat them.
The spear is a recommended weapon as it has high power even with just one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/307d8db0988b8f1851afe925991d4318cc8533eb.png[/img]
▲ If you have built up enough defensive gear by this point, you can significantly reduce damage taken, except for poison.
Balance your choices between defense and attack items as you progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/60882b6019b95ef344ae1f9bc1cc4815a6e8d877.png[/img]
▲ The Basilisk is a lightning-element monster, meaning it is weak to wind magic.
Use wind magic to deal effective damage.
By hovering over the attribute icon next to a monster's name, you can check its weaknesses.
If you're lucky enough to trigger a chain attack, you can deal even more damage and defeat it quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/fc374e3a51659434934c44cde22ab4f9beef48ec.png[/img]
▲ Continue balancing attack and defense items for the next monsters as well.
While some luck is involved with the slot system, you should be able to progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/fc374e3a51659434934c44cde22ab4f9beef48ec.png[/img]
▲ When experience reaches the level cap, you can level up and allocate points to your stats.
Considering your current equipment, it is generally best to focus on increasing physical defense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453892/386f41c52ce8cf4e4b0d42484958578f4a3583ce.png[/img]
▲ Every five stages, you will encounter a mid-boss or boss.
Defeating them rewards you with items that provide advantages in battle.
These items can only be used during the current adventure, but they will later become available for purchase at the item shop.

Even though a game over means you only keep your money, the experience will help you discover new strategies—"Maybe if I do this, it'll work?"
Embrace the challenge and enjoy the struggle!

notes.title: Priority of Activated Magic
notes.notes:
When two or more types of magic appear in the slot, the magic that activates is determined based on the following priority:

[olist]
[*] The one with the higher total value in the slot (including chain bonus) takes priority.
[*] If the total value is the same, the one that appeared first in the slot (closer to the top-left of the screen) takes priority.
[/olist]

[b]▼ Hovering over the magic attribute icon in the top-left of the screen will display a breakdown of the magic and the determined magic attribute.[/b]

notes.title: Early Access Version Released!
notes.notes:
[b]We have released the Early Access version today![/b]

Although we originally planned for a "March release," we had been making numerous minor fixes, which made it difficult to pinpoint a specific release date.
However, as we completed our final checks today, we decided to release it without further delay.

Since this is a roguelite game, you might find yourself hitting a game over quite quickly at first.
But little by little, you'll discover ways to progress!
Also, please note that the opening sequence is slightly different when you launch the game for the first time, so keep an eye out for that.

We’d love for you to play the game and share your thoughts or feedback on the discussion board!
Based on your input, we aim to refine the game into a more enjoyable and intuitive experience as we move towards the full release.

For improvements and bug reports, please post them in the "Early Access Ver. Improvement Board", which is only accessible for owners to write in.
However, anyone can view it.

For now, please dive into the world of "Sorcerer's Servant" and enjoy your adventure!

notes.title: We will launch early access for Sorcerer's Servant within March.
notes.notes:
We are now on track to launch the early access for *Sorcerer's Servant* within March!  

Initially, we were hoping for a February release, but since this is our first time launching on Steam, we've encountered a few unexpected challenges. As soon as the remaining concerns are resolved, we will proceed with the early access launch.  

### Remaining Concerns:  
1. The game is mistakenly labeled as not supporting Japanese, despite being a Japanese-made game.  
2. Pricing.  

Regarding (1):  
We originally thought, *"Menus look cooler in English, so let's make everything in English!"* However, we went too far, and Steam flagged the game as "not available in Japanese." To fix this, we’ve decided to partially localize the menus into Japanese.  

Today, we implemented the language-switching feature and added the necessary data. We'll begin testing tomorrow and expect to complete this within the week. Before launching early access, we’ll make sure the store no longer incorrectly displays "Japanese not supported."  

Regarding (2):  
We've seen the questions about pricing in the discussion threads and appreciate your interest! We're currently aiming for around $9, but since Steam allows for detailed pricing adjustments, we're taking some time to finalize the best option. Once we've made a decision, we'll update the store accordingly. Thanks for your patience!

If everything goes smoothly, we should be able to launch early access in the early part of March. Stay tuned, and thank you for your support!
